title: Municipal imports
intro: Review a complete source delivery before publishing it. Existing data stays intact during review.
no_datasets: No dataset is connected yet. Ask an administrator to register the Amsterdam dataset.
restrictions: General accessible parking does not mean unrestricted or currently available parking. Review all times, exceptions and notes in the source data.
missing_note: Missing records are candidates for investigation. This import does not delete or hide them. Manual visibility is preserved.
current_comparison: This comparison uses the current NIPKaart data. Counts and differences can therefore change after publication.
map_note: Source polygon with a derived map point; this point is not an entrance or individual parking bay.
derivations_notice: {{count}} records need a geometry check before publication.
geometry_confirm: I reviewed all {{count}} derived geometries against the source for use as map markers.
derived_note: The source geometry is invalid. Core proposes a separate repaired area and retains the original. Its parts are not individual parking spaces.
geometry_legend: Dashed orange: original source. Blue area: proposed derivation. Marker: derived map point.
deliveries_hint: Open a delivery to review the differences and record a decision.
no_deliveries_hint: Submit a source file. After validation, the delivery appears here for review.
upload_hint: The file is validated and compared. The map only changes after you approve the delivery.
records_hint: Select a row to inspect the map and source changes.
decision_hint: Approval publishes this entire delivery. Rejection leaves the map unchanged.
reason_placeholder: What did you check, and why are you approving or rejecting this delivery?
publication_enabled: Publication enabled; each delivery still requires review.
geometry_help: Compare the repaired area with the original source. Check whether the marker still represents the parking location.
